# MoCHII: fitted collisional line-cooling coefficients (all ions)
# Selected metal excitation model: mocassin_v2
#
#   Lambda_ion(T) = T^(-1/2) * sum_{i=1}^{N} A_i * exp(-T_i / T)
#
# Lambda_ion is a rate coefficient in erg cm^3 s^-1; the volumetric
# cooling rate of the ion is n_e * n_ion * Lambda_ion(T) [erg cm^-3 s^-1].
# A_i is in erg cm^3 s^-1 K^(1/2), T_i in K, T in K.
#
# Sources: identified excitation data recorded in each primary cooling file,
# including CHIANTI, Stout, and corrected supplied MOCASSIN models, in the optically thin n_e -> 0 limit of
# stationary collisions and radiative cascades among stable states.
# Bound collision-connected states use the checked physical energy selection.
# Nonnegative nodes use cubic interpolation unless it overshoots below zero;
# those channels use PCHIP through the same source nodes.
# Identified Stout temperature tables use log-PCHIP in T and Upsilon,
# with the adopted constant first-node Upsilon below the source interval.
# Coefficients describe the total fit and can be signed. No finite-density
# suppression is included. Fit provenance is recorded in each primary file; collected by
# tools/fitting/make_cooling_table.py from the cooling_<ion>.txt files,
# which remain the primary source (they carry the full provenance header).
#
# Columns:  ion  tag  N  fit_range_K  max_err_%  then N lines of  A_i  T_i
#
